score_note: decided_win_rate is wins / (wins + losses); row_win_rate is wins / n. Ties are always reported separately.

benchmarks.description: Stratified production traffic across sourcedAnswer, searchResults, and structured outputs.

methodology.design: Blind typed-output pairwise judge; deterministic randomized order; ties allowed

caveats: The structured projector score is a selected 319-row re-projection, not a fresh full run.
The frozen Deep replay dropped request date and domain filters.

benchmarks.description: Quality and filter compliance on production requests with domain or date constraints.

sample.source: 405,462 filtered production Deep requests from the prior 30 days
sample.method: Deterministic sample stratified across 11 filter combinations

arms.crunch: Vespa-only Crunch with immutable filters and defensive URL filtering
arms.comparator: Live Linkup Deep with the same filters

methodology.design: Blind typed-output pairwise judge with request filters visible

caveats: Date compliance could not be audited end-to-end because result documents omit last_modified.
Crunch lost the searchResults slice and had eight empty-result failures.

benchmarks.description: Enterprise sourced-answer traffic using internal Vespa retrieval without Brave.

sample.source: Unique production queries from one enterprise customer

arms.crunch: gemini-3.7-flash with Vespa lexical + semantic retrieval, RRF, and reranking

caveats: Single-customer traffic is not representative of all production traffic.
The sample deliberately includes a repeated wrapper pattern and is not volume-weighted.

benchmarks.description: Three-way enterprise comparison isolating Toolbox/Brave retrieval from Vespa-only retrieval.

sample.source: Unique production sourcedAnswer queries from one enterprise customer

methodology.design: Blind pairwise, no truncation, all 100 rows swap-checked

caveats: Small, single-customer sample.
The direct Toolbox/Vespa comparison is unresolved because swap instability exceeds the margin.

benchmarks.description: Pilot run used to detect evaluation bugs and choose ranking, stopping, and projection behavior.

methodology.design: Paired ablations against the same frozen Deep replay

caveats: The original 1,800-character prose result was invalid because it clipped Crunch disproportionately.
Small ablation slices are directional, not launch evidence.

benchmarks.description: Earlier live paired comparison on production depth=deep traffic.

methodology.design: Blind pairwise judge with randomized order and ties

caveats: 385 requests with unsupported date/domain filters were excluded.
Superseded by the newer stratified production-2,000 benchmark.

benchmarks.description: Google DeepMind multi-step research benchmark, dominated by exhaustive set-answer questions.

methodology.design: Official DeepSearchQA autorater contract, paired on identical questions

caveats: A replacement Gemini autorater was used because the originally specified model was unavailable to new API keys.
This measures the internal Crunch harness, not a fresh run of the public single-file implementation.

benchmarks.description: Chains, matrices, arithmetic, recency, and false-premise traps.

methodology.design: Atomic pre-authored success criteria, graded independently by Gemini and Fable

caveats: The sample is too small to distinguish Crunch from Exa.
The two judges disagree on the direction of the Crunch/Exa result.

benchmarks.description: Atomic requirement and citation checks on production-style questions.

methodology.design: Generate question-only checks, extract claim verdicts and URLs, then enforce URL allowlisting in code

caveats: On 73 real lookup queries Crunch and Exa tied; the overall margin came from agentic tasks.
This measures the internal harness, not a fresh public implementation run.

benchmarks.description: Structured projection fidelity and searchResults ranking quality.

methodology.structured: Project identical finished prose into schemas and compare against its prose ceiling
methodology.ranking: Compare arrival order, reciprocal-rank fusion, and cross-encoder ordering against gold-answer recall
methodology.head_to_head: Feed both top-10 lists through one fixed synthesizer, then judge pairwise

caveats: Projection token and latency costs were omitted.
The measured searchResults path still generated prose before discarding it.

benchmarks.description: Tests whether an explicit sequential-chain instruction improves multi-hop behavior.

methodology.design: Serial alternating A/B run, read blind against four fixed checks

caveats: Small sample with one human evaluator.
Most intermediate entities were likely known from model pretraining.
